records.jp: はぁ、はぁ……っ
records.en_original: *Pant* *pant*
records.en_auxiliary: *Pant* *pant*

records.jp: ど、どうにか……
records.en_original: We...beat it...
records.en_auxiliary: We...beat it...

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...

records.jp: 伶那さんっ！　それに……勇希も……！
records.en_original: Rena! Yuki!
records.en_auxiliary: Rena! Yuki!

records.jp: 思い出した
records.en_original: I remember now.
records.en_auxiliary: I remember now.

records.jp: 私は、勇希のことを聞いて、<CR>地元の病院まで行って、それで――
records.en_original: I went to the local hospital to ask about Yuki...
records.en_auxiliary: I went to the local hospital to ask about Yuki...
records.en: I remembered.<CR>I went to the local hospital to ask about Yuki, and then—

records.jp: あ、あのっ！　すいません……！
records.en_original: U-um! Excuse me...
records.en_auxiliary: U-um! Excuse me...

records.jp: ここに、勇希――金城勇希って女の子が<CR>来てたはずなんですけど……
records.en_original: I believe there's a girl here by the name of Yuki Kinjou...
records.en_auxiliary: I believe there's a girl here by the name of Yuki Kinjou...
records.en: Yuki—there should be a girl named Kinjou Yuki<CR>who came here...

records.jp: 申し訳ございません、どちら様でしょうか？
records.en_original: I'm sorry, who might you be?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, who might you be?

records.jp: その……友達の、宮内です！
records.en_original: I'm her...friend. Rena Miyauchi.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm her...friend. Rena Miyauchi.

records.jp: 宮内……ああ、あなたが！
records.en_original: Miyauchi... Oh, it's you!
records.en_auxiliary: Miyauchi... Oh, it's you!
records.en: Miyauchi... Ah, so you're the one!

records.jp: まさか本当に来るなんて思わなかったわ
records.en_original: I never thought you'd actually come.
records.en_auxiliary: I never thought you'd actually come.
records.en: I never thought you would actually come.

records.jp: ……！<CR>そ、その、今勇希はどこに……！
records.en_original: Then she's here?! Where is she?
records.en_auxiliary: Then she's here?! Where is she?

records.jp: ごめんなさい、患者さんのことは教えられないの
records.en_original: Apologies, but I can't disclose any information about our patients.
records.en_auxiliary: Apologies, but I can't disclose any information about our patients.
records.en: I'm sorry, but I can't disclose information about our patients.

records.jp: そんな……
records.en_original: Is that so...
records.en_auxiliary: Is that so...

records.jp: ただ、勇希ちゃんから手紙を預かってる。<CR>きっとあなたが来るだろうからって
records.en_original: Though I do have a note from Yuki. She expected that you would come.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I do have a note from Yuki. She expected that you would come.
records.en: But Yuki-chan left a letter for you.<CR>She said you would surely come.

records.en_original: What...?
records.en_auxiliary: What...?

records.jp: はい、これ
records.en_original: Here.
records.en_auxiliary: Here.

records.jp: 「あたしのことは、忘れて。<CR>伶那のことを好きになってくれる人は、きっといる」
records.en_original: "Please forget about me. I know there's someone out there who will love you, Rena."
records.en_auxiliary: "Please forget about me. I know there's someone out there who will love you, Rena."
records.en: "Forget about me.<CR>I'm sure you'll find someone who loves you, Rena."

records.jp: ゆう、き……
records.en_original: Yuki...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki...

records.jp: 伶那さん……
records.en_original: Rena...
records.en_auxiliary: Rena...

records.jp: 今は会えないって、分かって……
records.en_original: I knew I wouldn't be able to see her...
records.en_auxiliary: I knew I wouldn't be able to see her...
records.en: I realized I couldn't see her...

records.jp: 私はすごく苦しかった
records.en_original: It hurt so much.
records.en_auxiliary: It hurt so much.

records.jp: でも……
records.en_original: But...
records.en_auxiliary: But...

records.jp: 嫌われたわけじゃなかった……
records.en_original: You didn't hate me.
records.en_auxiliary: You didn't hate me.

records.jp: 施設に入ることが分かってた。<CR>だから勇希は、病気のことを黙ってた……
records.en_original: You knew you'd have to go to that facility some day. That's why you never told me you were sick.
records.en_auxiliary: You knew you'd have to go to that facility some day. That's why you never told me you were sick.
records.en: You knew you'd be admitted to a facility.<CR>That's why you hid your illness...

records.jp: 心配されたくなかったから
records.en_original: You didn't want me to worry.
records.en_auxiliary: You didn't want me to worry.
records.en: You didn't want me to worry.

records.jp: ……勇希の嘘は、優しい嘘だったんだね
records.en_original: Your lie was a kind one.
records.en_auxiliary: Your lie was a kind one.
records.en: That was a kind lie, Yuki.

records.jp: あ、はは。そういうことだったみたい……
records.en_original: Haha... I guess it was...
records.en_auxiliary: Haha... I guess it was...

records.jp: フラグメントの再接続を確認しました。<CR>世界構築の安定性低下に注意してください
records.en_original: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en_auxiliary: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en: Fragment reconnection confirmed.<CR>Caution: world construction stability has decreased.

records.en_original: Oh!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh!

records.jp: そして、私は決めた
records.en_original: That was when I made up my mind.
records.en_auxiliary: That was when I made up my mind.

records.jp: 何年、何十年経ってもいい。<CR>灰病の治療法がないっていうなら――
records.en_original: No matter how long it took. Years, decades. As long as there was no cure for Ash Syndrome...
records.en_auxiliary: No matter how long it took. Years, decades. As long as there was no cure for Ash Syndrome...
records.en: I didn't care if it took years or decades.<CR>If there was no cure for Ash Syndrome—

records.jp: 私が見つけて、勇希を治してやる！！
records.en_original: I'll find it myself! I'll cure Yuki!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll find it myself! I'll cure Yuki!
records.en: I would find one and cure Yuki myself!!

records.jp: 勇希を、治す……？　それって――
records.en_original: Cure Yuki? You mean—
records.en_auxiliary: Cure Yuki? You mean—

records.jp: みんなに、話さないといけないことがある
records.en_original: Everyone, I need to talk to you about something.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone, I need to talk to you about something.
records.en: There's something I need to tell everyone.

records.jp: 何か分かったんですか？
records.en_original: Have you realized something?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you realized something?

records.jp: 灰と、灰病について
records.en_original: It's about Ash and Ash Syndrome.
records.en_auxiliary: It's about Ash and Ash Syndrome.
records.en: About the Ash and Ash Syndrome.

records.jp: 私は、灰の研究を行う機関に入って……<CR>そこで、リフレクターになった
records.en_original: I joined an organization that researches the Ash. That's where I became a Reflector.
records.en_auxiliary: I joined an organization that researches the Ash. That's where I became a Reflector.
records.en: I joined an organization that researched the Ash...<CR>and became a Reflector there.

records.jp: <CLGR>伶那<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Rena's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Rena's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has been unlocked<CR>in <CLGR>Rena's<CLNR> Talents.
